verified_facts.text: Alila Seminyak is a beachfront resort on Bali's southwest coast, steps from the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: mere steps from the Indian Ocean, Alila Seminyak epitomizes what laid-back luxury looks and feels like. This stunning beachfront resort

verified_facts.text: The resort occupies the quieter end of a beach that stretches north from Kuta and Legian.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Seminyak occupies the quieter end of a sun-drenched beach that stretches 5 miles north from Kuta and Legian.

verified_facts.text: Seminyak offers beginner surfing, sunsets and beach clubs including Ku De Ta and Potato Head.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seminyak combines great beginner surfing, legendary sunsets and some of Bali’s most glamorous beach clubs, including Ku De Ta and Potato Head.

verified_facts.text: The resort is near Pura Petitenget temple, where traditional dance rehearsals take place at the Bale Agung pavilion across the temple.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Seminyak is near one of its most unique temples, Pura Petitenget. Witness festive anniversary celebrations on the Balinese calendar and take in traditional dance rehearsals at the Bale Agung pavilion across the temple.

verified_facts.text: The resort has five infinity pools integrated throughout the grounds, including the Main Pool attached to Beach Bar, the Family Pool and the Serene Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: infinity swimming pools, five in all, integrated throughout the grounds of the resort, including the Main Pool attached to Beach Bar, the Family Pool, and the Serene Pool.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites combine contemporary Balinese design, and each has a private terrace or balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our rooms and suites weave contemporary Balinese design with thoughtful amenities and stunning views. These serene hideaways each feature a private terrace or balcony for seamless indoor-outdoor living.

verified_facts.text: The Alila Penthouse has three king bedrooms, a separate living area, a private pool, a sun deck and multiple balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in sweeping island views from this 811 sqm penthouse suite, furnished with three king bedrooms, separate living area, private pool, sun deck, and multiple balconies.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Suite, one of the hotel's largest, has two separate living areas, a dining area and a wraparound balcony with beach views.
verified_facts.excerpt: one of the hotel’s largest, with one king bed, two separate living areas, a dining area, and a furnished wraparound balcony with beach views.

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila offers therapeutic massages including the signature Alila Seminyak Massage, and guests can customize their own wellness rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from an extensive selection of therapeutic massages, including the signature Alila Seminyak Massage, or customize your own wellness rituals.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has a gym and the Movement Studio, a dedicated space for yoga and mindful practice, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fitness centre at Alila Seminyak features a gym with state-of-the-art equipment and the Movement Studio - a dedicated space for yoga and mindful practice. Flooded with natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows throughout

verified_facts.text: Resort activities include morning yoga, sound bath meditation, mat Pilates, Balinese dance, creative workshops and face painting for younger guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: from morning yoga, sound bath meditation, and mat Pilates to Balinese dance, creative workshops, and playful face painting for younger guests.

verified_facts.text: The resort has its own Segara Temple, where guests can make offerings and take part in a Melukat water blessing led by the temple priest, Bapak Mangku.
verified_facts.excerpt: Participate in a Melukat water blessing led by Bapak Mangku, the temple priest, to cleanse and recalibrate body, mind and spirit.

verified_facts.text: The resort has its own Segara Temple.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore Alila’s own Segara Temple, where stories of the land and spiritual legacy are shared with care and meaning.

verified_facts.text: A John Hardy Workshop experience in Mambal Village lets guests shape jewelry designs in wax alongside master artisans, followed by a Long Table lunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Become an artisan for the day at the legendary John Hardy Workshop, where you’ll design silver jewelry in wax and share stories over a communal feast.

verified_facts.text: Seasalt serves wild-caught and sustainably harvested seafood from local waters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Seminyak honors this longstanding tradition with Seasalt and its menu of wild-caught and sustainably harvested seafood from local waters.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Bar offers daybeds and lounge chairs, Alila signature cocktails, thin-crust pizzas and Mediterranean bites by the waves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sink into the comfort of a daybed or lounge chair with an aperitif or an Alila signature cocktail, served alongside thin-crust pizzas and Mediterranean bites.

verified_facts.text: Play Alila offers activities designed for younger guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Playtime perfection awaits younger guests at Play Alila. Unleash their imagination through fun-filled activities designed just for them.

verified_facts.text: The resort's green initiatives include sensitive property planning, its own hydroponic garden and support for local schools.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort’s green initiatives range from sensitive property planning that works with the natural landscape to growing our own hydroponic garden and supporting local schools.

verified_facts.text: Ngurah Rai International Airport is 12 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)

12 Kilometers

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes clean lines, minimalist furniture and a rooftop bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its low-key, albeit high-luxe design—think clean lines, minimalist furniture, and a buzzy rooftop watering hole—helps it to fit right in with its surroundings.
